meta_description: KG Plumbing Middlesbrough. Emergency plumbing, repairs, and installations. Fast response, local engineers, no hidden charges. Call now.
hero_subhead: Burst pipe or boiler breakdown? KG Plumbing reaches you in under an hour, day or night, with honest prices and no call-out fee.
services_subhead: From emergency callouts to full system installations, we handle every plumbing job with the same care and speed.

services.title: Emergency Plumbing
services.desc: Burst pipes, leaks, and blockages fixed fast. We're on call 24/7 and aim to be with you in under an hour, any time of day or night.

services.title: Boiler Repairs & Installation
services.desc: Faulty heating repaired or replaced with a new efficient system. All work carries a warranty and we handle the paperwork for your insurer.

services.title: Radiator & Central Heating
services.desc: Cold radiators, trapped air, or noisy systems diagnosed and fixed. We balance your system for even warmth and lower energy bills.

services.title: Tap & Valve Repairs
services.desc: Dripping taps, seized valves, and water pressure issues sorted. We replace worn washers or fit new taps without unnecessary cost.

services.title: Blocked Drain Clearance
services.desc: Hair, grease, and debris cleared fast using professional tools. We find the cause and advise how to prevent it happening again.

services.title: Bathroom & Kitchen Plumbing
services.desc: Pipework for new suites, relocating supplies, and finishing to building regs. We work tidily and finish on time.

about_pullquote: I started KG Plumbing because I was tired of seeing customers overcharged for simple fixes.
about_para_1: KG Plumbing was founded on the principle that an emergency shouldn't cost the earth. With over 15 years' experience in the trade, we've built our reputation by turning up on time, doing the job right, and charging honestly. We're Gas Safe Registered and carry full public liability insurance — your peace of mind is built into every job.
about_para_2: Our customers come back because we treat their home with respect and explain what's wrong before we fix it. Whether it's a midnight burst pipe or a planned boiler upgrade, we bring the right parts and tools, work cleanly, and leave your home as we find it. That's why over 80% of our work comes from repeat customers and personal recommendations.
reviews_heading: What Middlesbrough Homeowners Say About KG Plumbing

reviews.text: Had a burst pipe under the kitchen at half eight on a Saturday night. KG Plumbing answered straightaway, arrived within 45 minutes, and had it capped and pressure tested before bed. Professional, no faffing about, and the price was exactly what he quoted. Can't ask for more than that.
reviews.author: Mike T.

reviews.text: Our boiler packed in two days before Christmas. I was dreading the bill but Kevin came round, diagnosed a faulty valve, replaced it, and we had heating again for under £200. He could have sold us a new boiler but he didn't. That's integrity. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Rachel H.

reviews.text: Blocked drain that the council said would take three weeks. KG Plumbing cleared it the next morning with a drain rod. No mess, no nonsense, friendly bloke. Will definitely use again if we need them.
reviews.author: David L.
